name: Paper Fold
description: They crease like a photo print, fold into an origami crane, and fly off.
camera: Locked-off shot of the character {place}, standing still and smiling at the camera.

beats.action: Sharp paper creases appear across the character and their clothes, as if they were printed on a glossy photo.
They fold along the creases, again and again, with clean paper corners, and become a small origami crane printed with their outfit's colors and patterns, hovering in the air.
The crane flaps twice and glides out of the frame. The background stays completely real and unchanged. No body parts are visible once folded.

product: The product items fold into small paper shapes and follow the crane.
sound: crisp paper creases in rhythm, one soft flutter of wings, a gentle marimba.
